what_we_know: Menswear and accessories; the site calls itself independent, family-run menswear built on close relationships, and refers to the brand as Far Afield in places. Clothing: knitwear, outerwear, polos, shirts, shorts, sweatshirts, swim shorts, tees, trousers. Accessories: bags, hats, home goods, socks. Founded 2016 per the home page; Brighton is its hometown; Mark Scholes is named Creative Director. The only production named is a family-run knitwear workshop in Istanbul. No store addresses on the home page; a Stockists page lists or features shops in Brighton, Toronto, Ottawa, Indonesia and Brooklyn. Prices show in GBP (shirts about 85 to 165) with a country and currency selector set to the United Kingdom. Nav: New Arrivals, Clothing, Accessories, Culture (Far Afield: About Us, Lookbook Archive, Manufacturing & Sustainability, Stockists; Music; The Journal), Sale. Nothing indicates a women's range.
